page.overview:
Who is Martin Krebs?

Martin Krebs was a representative for Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering who claimed that with the DNA of the world's largest dinosaurs, he can cure heart disease. He is one of the two main antagonists (alongside the Distortus rex) in .

In 2027, Martin Krebs is contacted by his employer Mr. Parker to retrieve blood samples from the three largest dinosaurs, which can cure heart disease. The creatures are located on an abandoned island, Ile Saint-Hubert, formerly owned by InGen. Due to its equatorial climate, which is similar to that of 60 million years ago, it's one of the few places on Earth where dinosaurs can survive by 2027.

Whilst driving in New York City, Krebs witnesses a sick and dying Apatosaurus in the streets. He stops his car and exits the vehicle and briefly looks at it while the authorities attempt to control the large herbivore. Krebs then gets back into his car, where he meets Zora Bennett, who Krebs has recruited for a top secret mission. They both discuss the mission as Bennett exits the vehicle.

Krebs parks the car and chases after Bennett, where Krebs informs Zora that the mission isn’t legal and that they are bringing a civilian to the mission. The two then go to a nearby museum where Dr. Henry Loomis, who is overseeing various artifacts of the museum’s collection being taken away due to low ticket sales, is working. Krebs tells Zora that Henry has been assisting Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering with research. The three of them discussed the mission with Henry not being sure if he should go, but Zora and Krebs are able to convince him. Loomis then says that they need blood samples from Quetzalcoatlus, Mosasaurus, and Titanosaurus to develop a drug called Paleodioxin that could cure heart disease.
